method.inventory: git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard; existing regular files only; task work/ excluded
method.loc: Physical nonblank lines, including comments and docstrings. Not a complexity or time estimate.
method.excluded_from_source: wwwroot/lib, *.min.js, *.min.css; ignored environments/builds/runs/model caches and .migration-backups not traversed
method.imports: AST static imports, including conditional/function-local imports, resolvable literal dynamic imports and package initializers. Conservative possible closure; not runtime proof or a deletion allow-list.
method.duplicate_method: Exact byte hash matches for source files >=30 nonblank lines; no claim about semantic duplication
